short_prompt: Illustrate a connected six-level mountain bunker with varied rooms and English callouts. Choose a useful cutaway view and develop architectural detail before finishing.
intent: Six connected occupied levels with explicit supported stairs, real apertures, program assemblies and a sectioned mountain. This bundled fixture explicitly selects hub; spine and branched have their own examples. Default exploration uses selection policy 3 to choose reproducibly among equally qualified supported candidates. Ring and stepped remain unsupported.

relationships: existing typed interfaces or localized attachments

negative_controls: Incorrect inventory; floating worker, displaced route endpoint, detached attachment or shaft/bearing misalignment where the actual fixture defines them.
limits: No final-pixel observation is supplied by these geometry commands.
Coverage partial remains partial; a schema number or successful loader cannot promote it to complete strict coverage.
No load, dynamics, hydraulic or biomechanical certification.
